posts.text: this sounds less like there's something fundamentally wrong with devin, and more some tweaks that need to happen on sales enablement

quotedTweet.text:
So I know Cognition doesn’t care about Little Ole’ Me, and this is just my story, so take it with a grain of salt, but here’s why I don’t think all these crazy scaling revenue numbers by coding agents are going to stick:

We’ve been happy Devin users for a while. Really like the product, and like the company. Still do! This isn’t shade at Cognition, and I’m not upset with them, just a sample of why I worry about the competitive landscape for these cos. 

Anyway, our usage grew to >$100k run rate or so. I think one or two of our users even received an email congratulating them for being Top 200 users of Devin. 

As usage grew, we added more capabilities and needed a BAA (layman’s terms: an agreement that says they are HIPAA compliant). This required an Enterprise contract (why a piece of paper requires extra money is a topic for another discussion, but it’s very normal…) so we started talking to their sales team. 

Basically, we were going to ~1.5x our spend in order to get the BAA. Honestly, that was fine with us. We like Devin!

Our only request was to pay quarterly (already a big concession from our existing monthly payments, given our relatively small size). They declined, unless we committed to EVEN MORE usage. 

Before responding, I decided to see how difficult it would be to set up Hermes to do the equivalent work as Devin, and to see what the costs were. I’d host it in our infrastructure and only use providers we already have a BAA with. 

Two days. 

That’s it. It’s functionally 100% equivalent. Maybe slightly better in some ways, slightly worse in others. We spend a little bit of time futzing with it, but we did that with Devin, too. 

The cost is roughly 25% of Devin. 

So, two days for $100k or so per year savings. All because they didn’t want us to pay quarterly. 

At some point, other companies are going to catch onto this, too. So congrats on this milestone, but keep finding more ways to provide value and keep customers happy. It’s hard to compete.
quotedTweet.translationZh:
我知道 Cognition 并不在乎我这个小人物，而且这只是我的个人经历，所以仅供参考。但这就是为什么我认为编码 Agent 那些疯狂增长的收入数字很难长期维持：

我们用 Devin 已经有一段时间了，也一直很满意。很喜欢这个产品，也喜欢这家公司。现在仍然如此！这不是在黑 Cognition，我也没有对他们不满，只是一个例子，说明我为什么担心这些公司的竞争格局。

总之，我们的使用量增长到了大约 10 万美元以上的年化支出。我记得我们甚至有一两位用户收到过邮件，祝贺他们成为 Devin 前 200 名用户。

随着使用量增长，我们增加了更多能力，也需要一份 BAA（通俗说，就是一份表明他们符合 HIPAA 合规要求的协议）。这需要签企业合同（一张纸为什么要额外收费是另一个话题，但这很常见……），所以我们开始和他们的销售团队沟通。

基本上，为了拿到 BAA，我们的支出要增加到约 1.5 倍。说实话，我们可以接受。我们喜欢 Devin！

我们唯一的要求是按季度付款（考虑到我们规模相对较小，这已经比现有的月付做出了很大让步）。他们拒绝了，除非我们承诺更多使用量。

在回复之前，我决定先看看把 Hermes 配置成能做 Devin 等效工作的难度，以及成本是多少。我会把它部署在我们自己的基础设施里，并且只使用已经和我们签过 BAA 的服务商。

两天。

就这样。功能上几乎 100% 等效。某些方面可能略好，某些方面略差。我们会花一点时间调试它，但用 Devin 时也一样。

成本大约是 Devin 的 25%。

所以，两天换来每年约 10 万美元的节省。全因为他们不想让我们按季度付款。

某个时候，其他公司也会意识到这一点。所以恭喜你们达到这个里程碑，但也请继续寻找更多方式提供价值，并让客户满意。竞争真的很难。

Hi @clairlemon. I've been thinking about the possibility of 'conscious AI' since 2009 (https://t.co/VCtZaYIrXJ). I am a vocal skeptic, but I don't think it helps to characterise those who think AI might be conscious as 'insane'. 好奇大家现在还会线下看脱口秀吗？

昨天和一个在杭州全职做脱口秀的同学吃饭，聊了不少行业里的事。

脱口秀好玩的地方，本来就是把很多大家心里有、平时又不太会直接说的东西以一种调侃方式讲出来。如果能聊的东西越来越少，最后最难的可能不是怎么把段子写好，而是还能不能讲出点真实的东西。

当然，这只是我同学作为从业者的一线体感，我也就是吃饭时听来的转述😂
